verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents a built-in assistant, Amplitude AI, that answers plain-language questions across your data, so users can hand off analysis questions without SQL or building dashboards. The evidence shows Q&A-style answers, not an assistant that carries out multi-step tasks or actions such as building charts, cohorts or experiments. The embedded agent that 'completes tasks' is something customers deploy for their own end users, not an assistant for the Amplitude user. Missing for 10: documented task execution/actions by the in-product assistant, depth of agentic capabilities, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Ask questions in plain language — Amplitude AI surfaces answers across all your data.
Start a conversation about your users or product and get expert-level answers in seconds that you can share with your whole org. No SQL, configuring dashboards, or waiting on the data team.
